page.overview:
Who is Terumi Nishii?

Graduating from , Nishii was an animator previously affiliated with [http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/company.php?id=155 Studio Cockpit] before working freelance. She is noted to be an avid fan of the series, and is in charge of character design for Netflix's upcoming [https://www.imdb.com/title/tt6908976/ Saint Seiya: Knights of the Zodiac]. Other series she's worked on as chief animation director include , , and .

Nishii and Mitsuko Baba are often cited as having similar styles to [http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/people.php?id=64 Yoshihiko Umakoshi], the three of them influenced by the works of .

Nishii also draws , most notably her original series, "[http://www.isotope.pictures/#!crown-of-uroboros/b71tw Crown of Uroboros]," which she sells annually at within her [https://twitter.com/order_bbm BBM] / BKM circle.
